system.description: You chant a sacred hymn, invigorating all around you. Sustained. While you chant, you cannot cast other spells.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and foes that can hear you are Slowed on their next turn as the music overwhelms them.
outcomes.success: Every ally within 30' regains 2d6 HP when you cast it, and d6 HP at the start of each of your turns while you sustain it.
outcomes.failure: Every ally within 30' regains d6 HP, and the spell cannot be sustained.
outcomes.ruin: Your voice cracks: you are Silenced until the end of your next turn. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
